name: What are the common signs of water damage in a ceiling?

mainEntity.name: What are the common signs of water damage in a ceiling?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs of water damage in a ceiling include discoloration, sagging plaster or drywall, peeling paint, and a musty odor. You might also notice drips or a persistent wet spot. Early detection is crucial, as prolonged water exposure can lead to structural damage and mold growth. Our team at Maine Results, Inc. recommends a professional inspection if you observe any of these indicators, especially if the source of the water is not immediately obvious, to prevent further deterioration and ensure a comprehensive repair plan.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for discoloration, sagging, peeling paint, or a musty smell in your ceiling. Early detection helps prevent structural issues and mold.
